race.comment: MAURLEN COMPASS (2) will enjoy a class drop after tackling top filly Bettor Beach last start. Came from the back row to win at Shepparton prior. Should get her chance from this draw. OWEN THE SAINTS (8) took advantage of a good draw to lead and score last time out by 9 metres in a strong performance at Shepparton. Draws on the second line but with even luck he can make it two on the bounce. MAJOR ORION (3) came from the back row when placed behind OWEN THE SAINTS last week. Much better drawn and won at this circuit and distance three back. Could turn the tables. JILLIBY ILLUSION (6) could be close to a win following back-to-back placings, the latest from this barrier.
